owner_statement: D-P5.6-PLAN-AUTH: I, mayank-admin, authorize planning, read-only repository analysis, and official primary-source research only for P5.6 Administration, Security, And Operations. The authorized planning scope includes the Admin Center, Security Center, and Operations Center; organization, department, user, role, permission, policy, and capability management; least-privilege RBAC and guarded ABAC evaluation; administrative approval and separation-of-duty workflows; camera, stream, integration, provider, resource-profile, model-lane, feature-flag, configuration, retention-policy, and deployment-profile governance as non-effective control projections; immutable audit, security, configuration, access, and administrative-event views; secret-reference and credential-provider governance without resolving secrets; system health, service inventory, dependency health, queues, workers, storage, database, event-bus, media-edge, AI-runtime, and infrastructure status projections; low-cardinality observability, SLO, error-budget, degradation, recovery, kill-switch, maintenance, backup, disaster-recovery, and capacity views; compliance, policy versioning, exception, attestation, review, and evidence-reference workflows; dynamic low-resource, enhanced-workstation, control-room, GPU-lab, server, and Kubernetes profiles without runtime activation; department isolation, ETag, revision, idempotency, concurrency, conflict-recovery, accessibility, localization, responsive, and multi-monitor requirements; generated-only fixtures and validation; producer-gap and threat inventories; owner decision options; and a bounded P5.6 implementation and start plan. Planning must preserve all accepted Phase 0 through P5.5 contracts and safety boundaries. Administrative controls must remain non-operative until independently authorized backend producers and enforcement paths exist. No UI action may directly change infrastructure, credentials, evidence, retention, models, cameras, streams, providers, deployments, or operational authority. Internet research is limited to official primary technical, security, accessibility, identity, privacy, audit, compliance, observability, reliability, database, container, Kubernetes, and standards sources. Local planning documentation, generated/static planning validation, and one checkpoint commit without push are authorized. This does not authorize product or test implementation, source import, dependency installation or lockfile changes, backend routes or migrations, frontend or browser runtime, credentials or secret resolution, administrative mutations, real providers or network access, cameras or media, Government or private data, models, datasets, artifacts or inference, operational alerts or actions, scanners, backup or restore execution, containers, Kubernetes execution, deployment, P5.7, or remote Git.
